reference_fidelity.rule: one output attribute should have at most one strict source; these levels are project heuristics, not vendor parameters.

completion.label: conservative_completion
completion.rule: not-visible regions remain designed extensions, never observed facts.

human_presence.label: human_presence
human_presence.rule: human presence changes presentation, not identity geometry or age unless explicitly requested.

prompt_skeleton: Keep the reference identity and costume architecture as the primary asset source.
Use the reference style/material/lighting channels according to the fidelity matrix, but keep the background white or neutral.
Complete unseen lower-body or footwear regions conservatively at the selected completion level; do not invent new major design motifs.
Preserve design density and wear state across newly completed regions.
Increase human presence through soft tissue, regional skin response, subtle natural asymmetry and camera realism without reshaping the face.
note: Style-on-Asset preserves reference flavor without copying the original environment.
